name: Meta publishes Muse Glimmer 30B technical report
title: Meta publishes Muse Glimmer 30B technical report
summary: Meta published the technical report for Muse Glimmer, a 30B open-weight model built for agentic tasks on a Mac or PC with one consumer GPU at 4-bit precision. Meta says it leads comparably sized open models on tool use and multi-step planning.
